name: AI SEO Masterclass - Module 9 Tools Tech Stack and Implementation
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
The author's tool stack, budget tiers, WordPress setup for AI SEO, automation ideas and a 4-week implementation timeline. Much of the module promotes his own products (LocalRank.so, Trackings.ai).

# Tool tiers (as taught)
- **Tier 1:** Ahrefs, LocalRank.so (heatmap rank tracking, citations, LLM citations, "Direction Boost", leads database, GBP autopilot), Trackings.ai, ChatGPT Plus, Google Search Console.
- **Tier 2 (past $5K per month):** Claude Pro, SurferSEO, SE Ranking, Screaming Frog.
- **Tier 3:** Semrush, Pitchbox, Koala AI, Clearscope.
- Rule of thumb: tools under 10% of monthly revenue.

# WordPress setup
GeneratePress theme, Rank Math Pro, WP Rocket, Schema Pro, ShortPixel, table of contents and table plugins, Instant Indexing (Google Indexing API). Config: `/%postname%/` permalinks, breadcrumbs, sitemap, FAQ schema on listicles, Article schema on posts, Cloudflare CDN, PageSpeed 90+ mobile.

# robots.txt for AI crawlers
Allow GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended. The author calls blocking AI crawlers the number one technical mistake.

# Automation ideas
Brief-to-draft-to-WordPress pipelines (Zapier, Make, n8n), citation and backlink alerts, automated white-label client reports, social distribution drafts.

# Implementation timeline
Week 1 tools, GA4/GSC, WordPress, schema and robots; week 2 templates and first 3 pieces; week 3 automations and alerts; week 4 publish, index, test in ChatGPT after 48 hours.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- TAG already runs on [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas) (OTTO, rank tracking, LLM visibility) instead of LocalRank/Trackings.ai, and Kim needs approval before any paid tool.
- Checking robots.txt for AI crawler access is a quick, free audit item for every client site.
- The "Direction Boost" (paid drivers requesting directions) is engagement manipulation; not a TAG tactic.
- Client sites are read-only for Claude; plugin and robots changes go to Kim as a fix list.
